cohort: 558 low-socioeconomic status pregnant women without depression, recruited from primary care clinics in São Paulo, Brazil
finding: There was no association found between type of delivery and maternal depression 6 to 16 months after delivery.
mod_finding: The study found no association between type of delivery (uncomplicated vaginal delivery, complicated vaginal delivery, or cesarean delivery) and maternal depression 6 to 16 months after childbirth.
